title: Letting Go
subtitle: Loosen your grip
description: For the thoughts you keep turning over. Notice what you are holding, feel where it sits in the body, and practise setting it down for a while.

title: Mindful Walk
subtitle: One step at a time
description: Take this one outside, or around the room. Attention rests on the feet, the ground and the rhythm of walking, and comes back there whenever it wanders.

title: Self-Compassion
subtitle: Kindness, turned inward
description: Speak to yourself the way you would speak to a good friend having a hard day. A gentle practice for when the inner voice has been harsh.

title: Evening Gratitude
subtitle: Three good things
description: Look back over the day and find three small things that went well. Stay with each one long enough to feel it, then let the day close.

title: Deep Focus
subtitle: Hold one thing in mind
description: A longer sit for training attention. Rest on a single anchor, notice each time the mind leaves, and return without fuss. Good before demanding work.

title: Coherent Breathing
subtitle: Five in, five out
description: An even, unhurried rhythm of five seconds in and five seconds out, paced by the sound of the sea. Simple, steadying, and easy to take anywhere.

title: The Relaxing Breath
subtitle: Four, seven, eight
description: Breathe in for four, hold for seven, and let a long breath out for eight. A short practice that tells the body it is safe to slow down.

title: Stress Release
subtitle: Unwind the day's tension
description: Find where the day has settled in the body, the jaw, the shoulders, the belly, and soften each place in turn with a slow out-breath.

title: Sleepy Body Scan
subtitle: Drift off part by part
description: Lie down, lights off. Attention moves slowly from the toes to the crown, and each part is allowed to grow heavy. No need to stay awake for the end.

title: Panic Pause
subtitle: When it all feels too much
description: Five minutes for a racing heart. Feel your feet, name what you can see and hear, and let a slow, even breath bring you back to the room.
